description: Eesti 3D liikluskorralduslikud rajatised LoD1 andmekogum is a dataset listed in Estonian National Geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportaal.maaruum.ee. 3D models of traffic management facilities include bridges and car tunnels resulting from the processing of ETD data. These 3D models have LoD1 (level of detail 1) detail, depicting objects (bridge plate in the case of bridges) as generalized cuboids. Coverage: EE. The portal shows the English title as "Estonian 3D traffic management facilities LoD1 dataset" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tunnel, avaandmed, tunnelid, sild, sillad. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ng-ee.
